title: Marriage-Based Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible applicants living inside the United States who want to apply for a green card through their U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident spouse.

title: Petition By Spouse Application
subtitle: For U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents petitioning for a spouse, with next steps for applicants inside or outside the United States.

title: Removal of Conditions Application
subtitle: For eligible conditional permanent residents seeking to remove the conditions on their two-year green card obtained through marriage.

title: Citizenship Application
subtitle: For eligible lawful permanent residents seeking U.S. citizenship through naturalization.

title: EB-1A Extraordinary Ability Application
subtitle: For individuals with sustained national or international acclaim in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics seeking an employment-based green card.

title: EB-1B Outstanding Professor or Researcher Application
subtitle: For internationally recognized professors and researchers with qualifying experience and a U.S. employer offering an eligible teaching or permanent research position.

title: EB-1C Multinational Manager or Executive Application
subtitle: For managers and executives with qualifying employment abroad seeking an employment-based green card through a related U.S. employer.

title: EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) Application
subtitle: For advanced-degree professionals and individuals with exceptional ability seeking an employment-based green card through a waiver of the job offer and labor certification requirements in the U.S. national interest.

title: EB-2 Employer-Sponsored Green Card Application
subtitle: For advanced-degree professionals and individuals with exceptional ability pursuing a green card through a U.S. employer, generally with PERM labor certification.

title: EB-3 Employer-Sponsored Green Card Application
subtitle: For skilled workers, professionals, and other workers pursuing a green card through a permanent U.S. job offer, generally with PERM labor certification.

title: Employment-Based Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible applicants inside the United States with an approved I-140 and an available visa seeking employment-based adjustment of status; includes guidance for eligible concurrent filings and family members.

title: H-1B Specialty Occupation Application
subtitle: For workers with a qualifying specialty occupation offer from a U.S. employer, including applicable cap registration, LCA, and I-129 petition steps.

title: O-1 Extraordinary Ability or Achievement Application
subtitle: For individuals with extraordinary ability or achievement pursuing temporary U.S. work through an eligible employer or agent under O-1A or O-1B.

title: Fiancé-Petitioned K-1 Visa Application
subtitle: For foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens planning to enter the United States to marry their petitioning partner within 90 days of admission.

title: Employment Authorization Document Application
subtitle: For eligible first-time and renewal applicants preparing Form I-765 to request employment authorization or an Employment Authorization Document.

title: Travel Document Application
subtitle: For eligible applicants seeking advance parole, a reentry permit, or a refugee travel document using Form I-131.

title: Extension of Status Application
subtitle: For eligible nonimmigrants seeking additional time in the United States, with guidance on I-539 filings and student or exchange program extensions.

title: Parent-Petitioned Consular Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible unmarried children under 21 living outside the United States who are sponsored by a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident parent.

title: Parent-Petitioned AOS Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible unmarried children under 21 living inside the United States who seek adjustment of status through a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident parent.

title: Child-Petitioned Consular Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible parents living outside the United States seeking permanent residence through sponsorship by their U.S. citizen child age 21 or older.

title: Child-Petitioned AOS Green Card Application
subtitle: For eligible parents living inside the United States seeking adjustment of status through sponsorship by their U.S. citizen child age 21 or older.

title: Green Card Renewal Application
subtitle: For eligible permanent residents renewing an expired or expiring 10-year green card, or replacing a lost, stolen, damaged, or incorrect card.

title: DACA Renewal Application
subtitle: For eligible DACA recipients seeking renewal of deferred action and associated work authorization. Initial requests cannot currently be granted under court restrictions.
